messages:
alex.chen: Quick handoff before I sign off — leaving notes and a couple of open remediation items. TL;DR: staging fix deployed for caching regression, DB failover test still flaky, need weekend coverage for synthetic checks. Full notes below.

alex.chen: Open items:
- GH-821: caching TTL bug — PR merged, deployed to staging (see PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/821). Monitoring looks clean but want one more 2h sweep.
- INC-4091 / PM-57: DB failover rehearsals intermittently fail under parallel load. Root cause suspected race in reconnect path; mitigation is the retry backoff change (WIP in GH-834).
- Postmortem follow-up: add deterministic replay to the failover test suite (owner: jin.park).

maria.gomez: Thanks Alex. Re: GH-821 — I kicked off a 2h synthetic that started ~10m ago. Will post summary. Also pinging @sam.patel to confirm weekend synthetic alerts are routed to mobile.

jin.park: I pulled logs for INC-4091 yesterday, saw the intermittent 502s from the connection pool. GH-834 fixes the backoff but I want a canary run against staging cluster with 50 concurrent failovers first. Planning that for Monday morning.

ops-bot: Deploy succeeded: PR #821 merged to staging by alex.chen at 2026-07-18T18:12:30Z. CI: ✅, E2E: 12/12 passed.

sam.patel: I'm happy to take weekend coverage. Can someone drop the smoke-check link here? I ran into flaky mobile alerts once last month.

maria.gomez: @sam.patel here's the smoke dashboard — https://internal.redwood/dashboard/smoke-checks — I just ran a check, output below:
```
2026-07-18T18:20:10Z smoke: ok: 120 reqs, p99=180ms
2026-07-18T18:30:10Z smoke: ok: 120 reqs, p99=190ms
2026-07-18T18:40:10Z smoke: ok: 120 reqs, p99=175ms
```
No errors seen in the last 30m. :thumbsup:

sam.patel: Got it, thanks. I'll keep an eye overnight and enable mobile alerts for critical > 5% error rate. If anything spikes I'll @channel.

jin.park: Quick note on the postmortem reopen threshold — per doc we reopen if recovery time > 3x baseline or if recurrence within 2 weeks. If the canary fails on Monday we should reopen and attach replay traces.

alex.chen: Agree. Jin — assign yourself as owner for the canary and post results in this thread. Maria — if the 2h sweep shows any regression, please escalate to me and sam.

maria.gomez: Will do. If everything stays green I'll mark GH-821 remediation as verified in the postmortem tracker.

sam.patel: I'm on call for coverage and will re-run the smoke check at 02:00 UTC. If I see >1% errors I'll escalate to oncall pager rotation.

alex.chen: Awesome — thanks everyone. Leaving contact: alex.chen (pager off after 18:45 UTC). Back at 09:00 Mon. :wave:

maria.gomez: :raised_hands: good handoff. See you Monday.

jin.park: I'll post canary results here Monday AM.

ops-bot: Reminder: oncall swap scheduled — sam.patel takes weekend primary 2026-07-18 20:00UTC to 2026-07-21 08:00UTC.
